newsitem.title: USA: Brent about steady in late day U.S. paper trade.
newsitem.headline: Brent about steady in late day U.S. paper trade.

text.p: World benchmark North Sea Brent crude oil prices held about steady in rather quiet late day U.S. paper trade Wednesday, traders said.
The only confirmed deal was a partial September cargo of 100 lots done at $18.28 a barrel, or just 1 cent below September Brent's earlier close on the IPE in London.
The August-September spread was notionally assessed at around +2 cents, with bids at +1-2 cents and offers at +3-4 cents.
The September-October and October-November spreads were assessed at -12/-9 cents and -12/-11 cents respectively.
The September Brent-West Texas Intermediate spread was pegged at -$1.38 a barrel, traders said.
